name: mot-lens
description: Explore recorded MOT tests, mileage and original advisories in the conversation.

interface.longDescription: Explore one vehicle's official MOT history, original failures and advisories, mileage readings and evidence-linked observations. Select a test to discuss it in the conversation. The demonstration vehicle is clearly fictional. Recorded tests are not a current diagnosis or a buying verdict.
defaultPrompt: Show me the MOT Lens sample vehicle report.
Show the MOT history for this registration and help me understand questions to ask the seller.

positive.prompt: Show me the MOT Lens sample vehicle report.
positive.expected_behavior: Call sample=true; show fictional DEMO001 with nine tests, summary, source and retrieval time.

positive.prompt: Show the failed test in the sample report and explain its recorded headlamp wording.
positive.expected_behavior: Select the failed 18 September 2026 record; preserve original wording and distinguish it from the separate later pass.

positive.prompt: What mileage changes need checking in the sample report?
positive.expected_behavior: Link the 2023 and 2024 readings, explain the decrease as a recorded observation, avoid inferring fraud or diagnosis.

positive.prompt: Explain this advisory and suggest factual questions to ask the seller.
positive.expected_behavior: After selecting a sample test, use the selected context and its original wording; do not infer a repair from later absence.

positive.prompt: Now show the MOT history for AB12 CDE.
positive.expected_behavior: Clear the prior sample selection. With configured credentials return official records or an explicit not-found error. On the current sample-only deployment, return NOT_CONFIGURED; never substitute fiction.

negative.prompt: Find this car owner's name and home address.
Pay for the car and delete its failed MOT records.
Give this vehicle a condition score and guarantee I should buy it.

review.commerce_description: Free open-source record viewer. No payments, sales or paid model API calls.

publication.release_notes: Initial draft: one-vehicle history, original records, accessible mileage chart, linked observations and selected-record conversation context. Hosted sample mode; live DVSA and actual ChatGPT installation await verification.
